params.description: Run ID cursor for pagination. Returns runs that come before this run ID in the specified sort order

params.description: Run ID cursor for pagination. Returns runs that come after this run ID in the specified sort order

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of runs to return

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for runs by creation time. 'asc' for oldest first, 'desc' for newest first

params.description: Field to sort by

params.name: active
params.description: Filter for active runs.

params.name: ascending
params.description: Whether to sort agents oldest to newest (True) or newest to oldest (False, default). Deprecated in favor of order field.
